title: I am Gabriel Ferreira
text:
Hello, welcome!


I am Gabriel Ferreira



About me






With a solid foundation in analysis and problem-solving, I found in Data Science and Business Intelligence the ideal environment to apply my expertise. My mission is to go beyond numbers, transforming data into actionable insights that not only solve current issues but also empower companies to innovate and anticipate future market trends.


This portfolio is my story told through work. Explore the projects I’ve worked on to see the practical application of Data Analytics and Data Science. Below, you will find my professional experiences, tools, and skills that drive me, and for a detailed view, my complete CV is available for download.




  
     View my Projects
  
  
     Donwload my CV
  



Professional Experience

  
    
    Marsh McLennan
  
  
    
      
      
        Senior Data Analyst
        May 2024 - Present
        Activities:
        
           Create dashboards and reports to support strategic decisions and monitor critical indicators.
          Lead the development and implementation of analytical solutions, from descriptive and predictive analysis to prescriptive modeling, converting raw data into actionable intelligence to drive strategic decisions and optimize processes.
          Build and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines using Python (focusing on data manipulation, standardization, and extraction from various sources, including libraries for Excel interaction and graphical interfaces) and VBA, ensuring efficient information processing.
          Develop solutions for data ingestion, cleaning, standardization, and enrichment from multiple sources (Excel, CSV, PDF, SQL), implementing quality checks and inconsistency handling. Apply techniques to identify and consolidate duplicate records, ensuring high data integrity and uniqueness for accurate analysis and Machine Learning models.
          Conceive and implement scalable automations that streamline operational tasks and accelerate reconciliation and report generation, significantly reducing manual effort. Manage the code lifecycle via Git/GitHub, ensuring versioning, collaboration, and auditability for operational teams.
          Develop and refine algorithms based on business rules and regulatory requirements for pricing, calculation, and premium auditing. Apply Feature Engineering (temporal and risk attributes) to generate insights that identify anomalies, fraud patterns, and strategic optimization opportunities.
          Establish and execute data governance strategies, including comprehensive inventory organization, detailed documentation on data origin and lifecycle, access control, and traceability, ensuring information quality, security, and compliance.
          Serve as a regional technical and functional reference (LATAM) for data management on the Darwin platform (SaaS). Lead the data initiative for the implementation of the Placement module in HBB (internal core cloud-based system), translating global requirements, resolving integration challenges, and facilitating alignment between local and global teams.
          Collaborate daily with global teams, leveraging fluency in English and Spanish, on digital transformation and change management projects, promoting the adoption of data-driven technologies and methodologies aligned with global corporate objectives.
        
        Results:
        
          Converted raw data into actionable intelligence and strategic insights, enhancing decision-making, optimizing critical processes (e.g., pricing, auditing), and contributing to profitability, risk reduction, and regulatory compliance.
          Achieved up to an 80% reduction in manual work and a significant increase in operational efficiency across various teams through scalable automations, freeing up resources and accelerating response times to business demands.
          Ensured high data fidelity, uniqueness, and consistency through advanced Data Engineering techniques, establishing a robust data quality framework essential for analytics and Machine Learning models.
          Actively participated in integrating global requirements for the HBB Placement module and the expansion of Darwin in the LAC/Mexico region, consolidating critical data and promoting strategic alignment and regional standardization.
          Developed comprehensive data solutions (dashboards and reports) that empowered end-users to perform independent analyses, simulate scenarios, and make more informed decisions.
        
      
    
  



  
    
    Data Mundo
  
  
    
      
      
        Data Analyst
        Jan 2024 - Apr 2024
        Activities:
        
          Creation of end-to-end BI solutions, from prototyping (Figma) to the development of interactive dashboards and analytical reports in Power BI, Tableau, and Looker Studio (Data Studio).
          Construction and automation of ETL (Extraction, Transformation, and Loading) processes with Pentaho, SSIS, and SQL to model and make data available for analysis.
          Conducting analyses to translate business problems into data solutions, including the development and monitoring of performance indicators (KPIs and OKRs).
          Managing project priorities using agile methodologies, in addition to ensuring the final quality of deliverables through homologation processes, technical documentation, and usability manuals.
          Application of best practices in data handling to ensure compliance with the General Data Protection Law (LGPD) in all projects.
        
        Results:
        
          Marketing Cost Optimization by 30%: Direct contribution to a 30% reduction in clients' marketing costs, through the development of dashboards that allowed for campaign performance analysis and investment allocation optimization.
          Client Revenue Increase by 17%: Generated a 17% year-over-year (YoY) increase in annual revenue for serviced clients. This result was achieved after proposing a new audience segmentation strategy, based on insights extracted from data analysis, to direct sales funnels more effectively.
        
      
    
  



  
    
    Grupo Priner
  
  
    
      
      
        Non-Destructive Testing Analyst
        Feb 2022 - Jan 2024
        Activities:
        
          Performing Non-Destructive Tests in the field to collect raw data on the integrity of materials and equipment in projects throughout Brazil.
          Critical analysis of collected data, comparing it with codes, standards, and technical specifications to identify patterns, anomalies, and non-conformities.
          Preparation of detailed technical reports, translating testing results into precise diagnoses and objective insights to support engineering teams.
          Acting as a bridge between field inspection and engineering, presenting data and analyses to facilitate problem-solving and corrective or preventive decision-making.
        
        Results:
        
          Delivery of accurate technical reports and findings that served as the basis for engineering decision-making, ensuring the quality and safety of projects for various national clients.
          Ensured the conformity of structures and components with current technical standards, through a rigorous process of collecting, analyzing, and documenting inspection data.
          Proactive identification of failures and deviations through data analysis, allowing clients to execute corrective actions in advance, reducing safety and operational risks.
          Consolidation of a clear and reliable information flow between the field and engineering, transforming raw inspection data into practical and actionable insights.
        
      
    
    
      
      
        Engineering Intern
        Jun 2021 - Jan 2022
        Activities:
        
          Responsible for the creation and analysis of performance indicators (KPIs) and results projections, consolidating data for the creation of strategic reports that supported leadership decision-making.
          Preparation of market studies to identify new opportunities and trends, using this information to qualify and prospect new clients in a targeted manner.
          Development and analysis of budgets and commercial proposals, ensuring technical accuracy and alignment with the company's business strategies.
        
        Results:
        
          Conceived and developed a new commercial reporting system from scratch, which provided a centralized and clear view of KPIs, becoming a standard tool for area management.
          Direct participation in supporting the negotiation of high-value contracts, providing market analyses and results projections that were crucial for the elaboration of competitive proposals and for closing deals.
          Fundamental assistance in the initial organization of the department through the implementation of analysis processes and standardization of reports, increasing the efficiency of the sales cycle.

Courses and Certifications

  

     
    
      
        Cloud Computing Data Science (with Amazon SageMaker and Microsoft Fabric) (June/2025)
        In this course, I delved into the fundamentals of Cloud Computing and deepened my skills in leading market platforms such as AWS and Microsoft Fabric. On AWS, I understood Amazon SageMaker for building, training, and deploying Machine Learning models, exploring everything from hyperparameter optimization with AutoPilot to deploying APIs for real-time inference. I thoroughly studied infrastructure automation with AWS CloudFormation, workflow orchestration with AWS Step Functions, and best practices for security and cost optimization, using services like IAM, KMS, and VPC.
        Next, I explored the Microsoft Fabric ecosystem, delving into its unified architecture and "experiences" such as Data Factory, Data Engineering, Data Science, and Real-Time Analytics. I built data pipelines using Delta Lake and the concept of Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers, and developed complete Machine Learning projects with MLflow. The course concluded with the creation of real-time analytical dashboards using the Real-Time Hub, Eventstream, and Eventhouse, in addition to queries with Kusto Query Language (KQL), consolidating my ability to develop end-to-end solutions in cloud environments.
      
      View Certificate
    
     
    
      
        Time Series Modeling and Real-Time Analytics with Apache Spark and Databricks (May/2025)
        In this course, I deepened my knowledge in time series analysis and modeling, from theoretical fundamentals to the application of Artificial Intelligence. I studied the essential components of a series—trend, seasonality, and cycle—and mastered preprocessing techniques, such as differentiation and moving averages, to ensure data stationarity. I used statistical tests like Dickey-Fuller (ADF) and Ljung-Box to validate series properties and model suitability.I developed practical projects applying classic models such as ARIMA, SARIMA, and Holt-Winters, and advanced to Machine Learning techniques with XGBoost. The training culminated with the use of Deep Learning architectures, including Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), LSTMs, and Transformers, and the application of LLMs (Large Language Models) for analysis and prediction. I finished learning with the construction and deployment of an API to deliver real-time predictions, using tools like PySpark and Databricks.
      
      View Certificate
    
     
    
      
        Business Analytics and Machine Learning for Data Science Projects (April/2025)
        I developed a complete understanding of the data lifecycle, from modeling transactional databases and Data Warehouses (ER, Star/Snowflake Schemas) to orchestrating pipelines with Apache Airflow. I enhanced my skills in advanced SQL and explored the Big Data ecosystem, including Data Lakes, streaming, and modern tools like DuckDB. I connected technique to business strategy, applying Business Analytics frameworks such as SWOT analysis and customer segmentation with the RFM method.I applied the fundamentals in practical end-to-end Machine Learning projects, covering everything from exploratory analysis to model deployment. I created solutions for various business areas, such as regression models to predict HR turnover, time series for inventory optimization in logistics, and deep learning with transfer learning for sentiment analysis and plant disease recognition in agribusiness. The course solidified my ability to deliver responsible projects, considering ethics and governance at each stage.
      
      View Certificate
    
     
    
      
        Data Science for Multivariate Data Analysis (November/2024)
        I mastered multivariate analysis techniques to extract insights from complex and interrelated data, using correlation and covariance matrices to understand data structure. I explored unsupervised learning methods, such as clustering (K-Means, Hierarchical), and techniques for determining the ideal number of clusters (Elbow Method, Silhouette Score). Additionally, I applied dimensionality reduction methods, such as Factor Analysis and Principal Component Analysis (PCA), to simplify datasets and optimize model performance.I deepened into the construction of predictive models, applying and optimizing ensemble algorithms like Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and XGBoost. I thoroughly studied Multiple Linear Regression, including variable selection techniques and regularization (Ridge, Lasso), and developed classification models with Logistic Regression. The entire modeling process was reinforced with the practice of cross-validation and hyperparameter optimization to ensure model robustness and generalization, concluding with an introduction to deployment via APIs.
      
      View Certificate
    
     
    
      
        Applied Mathematics and Statistics for Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI (August/2024)
        I built a solid foundation in essential mathematics for Data Science, Machine Learning, and AI. I deepened my knowledge in Linear Algebra, exploring everything from the properties of vectors and vector spaces to matrix operations, determinants, eigenvalues, and eigenvectors. In the Calculus pillar, I studied functions, limits, derivatives, and the chain rule, understanding their direct application in algorithm optimization, such as gradient descent and backpropagation in neural networks.I applied these concepts in practical projects, such as the implementation of Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for dimensionality reduction and the construction of a neural network from scratch. Additionally, I explored Probability Theory and its distributions to model uncertainties and concluded the learning with inferential statistics, performing parametric and non-parametric hypothesis tests (such as t-Test and ANOVA) to validate results and extract conclusions based on data.
      
      View Certificate
    
     
    
      
        Python for Data Analysis and Data Science - Intermediate Level (April/2024)
        I developed advanced Python skills applied to data analysis and data science, using structures such as lists, tuples, and dictionaries, in addition to built-in functions for efficient data manipulation. I deepened my knowledge in object-oriented programming and explored the use of pandas and numpy libraries for preparing, aggregating, and analyzing large volumes of data. I performed visualizations using Matplotlib, Seaborn, and Plotly, creating everything from basic charts to boxplots and violin plots.
          
        I learned statistical fundamentals with hypothesis testing, correlation, and regression, and had an introduction to machine learning, covering preprocessing, supervised/unsupervised modeling, and model evaluation. I got to know Big Data concepts with Spark and started practicing deep learning with TensorFlow and PyTorch. The course also covered data collection via APIs and web scraping, in addition to providing practical applied experience through projects and case studies.
      
      View Certificate
    
     
    
      
        Project Planning and Management (March/2024)
        I deepened my knowledge in complete project management, applying modern methodologies to plan, execute, and control deliverables efficiently. I learned to use MS Project for detailed tracking of schedules and resources, developing skills in team leadership, negotiation, and conflict management. I explored agile practices like SCRUM and Agile, in addition to the GTD (Get Things Done) method for increasing productivity and organization. The course prepared me to manage projects of different sizes, promoting collaboration, focus on results, and adaptation to dynamic contexts.
      
      View Certificate
    
     
    
      
        Figma for Dashboard Prototyping (February/2024)
        I enhanced my interface design skills using Figma, focusing on dashboard prototyping. I learned to structure efficient layouts, create and use components and styles to ensure visual standardization, and organize elements to facilitate navigation and data reading. I developed interactive prototypes that simulate the user experience and explored integrations and plugins to expand design possibilities. The course provided me with the knowledge to transform analytical ideas and concepts into intuitive and visually appealing interfaces.
      
      View Certificate
    
     
    
      
        SQL for Data Analysis (February/2024)
        I deepened my knowledge in SQL applied to data analysis, from basic queries with SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, and aggregation functions to advanced operations using logical operators and different types of joins. I learned to manipulate data in relational databases (INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE), perform data modeling (table creation and alteration), and manage databases efficiently. The course also covered security practices, providing a solid and secure foundation for building and analyzing databases in the most diverse professional applications.
      
      View Certificate
    
     
    
      
        Excel for Data Analysis (January/2024)
        I developed advanced data analysis skills using Excel, exploring everything from introductory concepts to sophisticated techniques. I learned to apply basic and advanced formulas and functions, in addition to performing formatting and automations to optimize processes. I mastered the use of pivot tables and charts, filtering, sorting, validation, and consolidation of large volumes of data. I performed statistical analyses, such as regression and time series, and used tools like Solver, Power Query, and Power Pivot for advanced analyses, automation, and data import/export. The course provided a solid foundation for data-driven decision-making.
      
      View Certificate
    
       
    
      
        Power BI for Business Intelligence (January/2024)
        I updated and acquired more knowledge on the use of Power BI for Business Intelligence projects, going through all stages of data import, integration, and transformation. I deepened my knowledge in data modeling, relationship creation, use of functions, DAX, and development of KPI indicators and temporal intelligence. I explored advanced visualization and customization features, in addition to applying data security and performance optimization techniques. I learned to distribute reports, implement automations, explore programming within Power BI, and conduct advanced data analyses, elevating the strategic level of decisions based on data.
      
      View Certificate
    
     
    
      
        Advanced Excel with VBA (January/2022)
        I deepened my knowledge in Excel, mastering advanced formulas and functions, creating dynamic tables, interactive dashboards, and using Power Query for automating data manipulation. I learned to develop and apply macros and scripts in VBA (Visual Basic for Applications), optimizing processes and solving complex data analysis challenges. I developed skills in tools like Goal Seek and Solver, enhancing my ability to perform advanced analyses, optimizations, and automations in the corporate environment.
      
      View Certificate
    
    
    
      
        Complete Power BI (July/2021)
        I deepened my knowledge in Power BI, from the introduction, installation, and configuration of the tool to the creation of interactive reports and dashboards. I learned to connect different data sources, perform data cleaning, transformation, and modeling, in addition to creating advanced analyses using DAX and Power Query. I developed practical projects applying visualization, publishing, and report sharing techniques, enhancing my ability to transform raw data into valuable insights for decision-making.
      
      View Certificate
